name: Cleric
description: Support-focused holy warriors who heal allies and smite foes with divine magic.

name: Crusader
description: A divine warrior wielding massive greathammers to smite evil.

name: Monk
description: Martial artist mixing stamina and focus for powerful spiritual strikes.

name: Paladin
description: Holy hammer fighter/guardian.

name: Barbarian
description: Ferocious warriors with raw physicality, wielding huge clubs to smash through enemy lines.

name: Berserker
description: Dominant warriors wielding massive greataxes for devastating sweeps. Wades directly into combat and stays there. Benefits from staying in combat and trading blows with enemies.

name: Marauder
description: A warrior type class that focuses on in-your-face combos. Trading blows is a plus as it increases damage capabilities. No nonsense axe combos.

name: Dragoon
description: Lithe spearmen harnessing faith-based leaps to pierce defenses.

name: Guardian
description: Balanced fighters wielding straight swords, equally adept with Strength and Dexterity.

name: Knight
description: A stalwart champion swinging massive two-handed greatswords.

name: Sentinel
description: Polearm specialists who combine extended reach with dexterous sweeps to control the battlefield.

name: Brute
description: A brawler that thrives on dodges and aggressive stamina use. Best suited for 1H clubs.

name: Cutthroat
description: Agile and flamboyant swordsmen relying on speed and precision.

name: Fencer
description: Elegant duelists adept at swift, precise thrusts and agile footwork.

name: Warlord
description: An honorable warrior wielding two-handed katanas with disciplined technique and mild arcane flair.

name: Assassin
description: Stealth, backstabs, off-hand empty.

name: Harbinger
description: A dark harbinger wielding scythes, merging necrotic spells with unholy fervor.

name: Rogue
description: Fast, stamina-heavy dual-wielder that thrives on hit-and-run tactics.

name: Wraith
description: Swift shinobi using ninjutsu illusions and quick slashes.

name: Frost Mage
description: A cold-themed mage who freezes, chills, and shatters enemies.

name: Plaguebearer
description: A diseased spellcaster spreading rot and plague across the battlefield.

name: Pyromancer
description: A mage class centered on fire—setting enemies ablaze, stacking burns, and causing explosions.

name: Storm Bringer
description: Lightning-focused mage—fast, volatile combat with chaining effects.
